race.comment: SHARES (3) will find this a fair  bit easier and should relish the rise to the mile. Stackhouse reunites after getting the job done on his at his second outing here. Bold showing anticipated. OUTSIDETHESQUARE (10) showed early speed from a good draw last time and raced on speed before drawing clear to score comfortably at Ballarat Synthetic. Brown takes over and she's certainly one to follow. HULKSTER (1) did well to score at this track two runs ago. Fair effort last time out when in the firing line on the turn only to miss the bob here over the same journey. Strips rock-hard fit and should be right there again at the business end. QUEEN BEIRA (11) did a great job to score over this course and distance last start. Taking on a better line-up this time but she is up to the challenge.
